text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- President Hosni Mubarak discusses at a ministerial meeting details of the South Valley development project. Mubarak to give the go ahead within days to start construction work at the area's pumping station.

- Mubarak receives on Sunday a report on the meeting of foreign ministers of the Damascus Declaration states. The two-day meeting, which started on Saturday, discusses the peace process and previous resolutions by the Arab League.
- Mubarak discusses with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat the outcome of Hebron negotiations. Reports on signing the agreement within the next two days after overcoming main differences.
- Tourist Nile cruiser runs aground while on its way to the southern town of Luxor to bring back to the capital a tourist group.
- Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri says in the year 2000 annual growth rate will reach at least seven percent and the privatisation programme will be completed.
- Presidential adviser Osama el-Baz says Israel's policies do not serve the interests of its people and economy.
